items.title: Aviva reports shrinking retirement and bulk purchase annuity sales in Q3 update
items.summary: Aviva's Q3 trading update reveals declining retirement and bulk purchase annuity sales alongside rising wealth net flows.

items.title: Kemi Badenoch appeals to investment managers for policy ideas
items.summary: Conservative Party leader Kemi Badenoch has asked investment managers to help address the UK's financial needs with policy suggestions.

items.title: AJ Bell to cut multi-asset charges to 0.25% alongside in-house fund launch
items.summary: AJ Bell is reducing multi-asset fund charges to 0.25% following the introduction of in-house index and allocation funds.

items.title: Sackers appoints Zak Ullah as associate in latest industry moves
items.summary: Sackers has added newly qualified lawyer Zak Ullah to its legal team as an associate.

items.title: JP Morgan questions pricing impact of Aon and Blackstone's Cortina syndicate launch
items.summary: JP Morgan has warned that the launch of Aon's Blackstone-backed Cortina syndicate at Lloyd's adds unhelpful capacity as catastrophe pricing falls.

items.title: Technology and data raise the bar for high net worth insurance advice, says Hiscox
items.summary: Matthew Perkin of Hiscox told a London forum that digital tools and customer access to data increase rather than replace the need for specialist broker advice.
